answer: Proof of burn limits Sybil attacks by requiring agents to verifiably destroy native tokens to register an identity. Whether coordinating pest control in an orchard, monitoring wild lotus marshes, or transcribing manuscripts drafted with a quill, peers authenticate agents against provably unspendable ledger entries. An attacker incurs the irreversible loss of financial capital per alias. However, this monetary barrier disenfranchises micro-agents lacking upfront reserves.
